title: Ground visual references and spatial associations
non_scope: No local or remote model weight training
No unilateral source corpus or pre-existing database mutation
No modification of SillyTavern runtime configuration
acceptance_criteria: Each accepted visual pair resolves to exact original media and approved association/description.
Unlabeled/conflicting images remain unresolved; generated captions cannot promote facts.
Map/text discrepancies and unknown spatial fields remain visible rather than silently reconciled.
All required visual categories are covered or explicitly blocked; asset tracking alone is not complete visual extraction.
description: Preserve the user's image-based knowledge and connect it to entities without hallucinated appearance or map topology.
